Class MessageRepository

java.lang.Object
Database.Repositories.MessageRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
IMessageRepository
public class MessageRepository extends Object implements IMessageRepository
The MessageRepository class provides database operations for Message objects. It implements CRUD functionality (create, read, update, delete) and helper methods to interact with the messages table in the database.
